skill.name: extension-stripe
skill.description: Guides Caffeine AI projects through Stripe Checkout integration for card payments across Motoko backends and React frontends.
skill.summary: Build Stripe Checkout flows with backend configuration, session creation, frontend redirects, and payment result routes.
skill.author: caffeinelabs

security_audit.summary: All 25 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, ordinary imports, template literals, and an informational link. Semantic review found client-controlled pricing and redirect URLs in the recommended checkout design.

remediation.issue: Checkout sessions accept client-supplied prices, descriptions, currencies, and quantities.
remediation.suggestion: Accept product identifiers and bounded quantities, then load authoritative product details and prices on the backend before creating a Stripe session.

remediation.issue: Checkout session callers can supply unrestricted success and cancellation URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Construct redirect URLs on the backend from an allowlisted application origin and reject every unapproved scheme, host, port, and path.

static_findings.snippet: There is the prefabricated module `mo:caffeineai-stripe/stripe.mo` that that cannot be modified. It
* If not, opens an admin panel and asks the user to initialze Stripe with `StripeConfiguration`.
* Note that JSON parsing of backend `createCheckoutSession` result is needed.
* Validate that the parsed session includes a non-empty `url`. If missing, throw an error and do not
* Redirect webpage to url in `CheckoutSession`: This allows the user to complete the payment.
* Do NOT use router navigation for the Stripe URL. Use `window.location.href`.
* Never navigate to `/undefined`; if `session.url` is missing, show an error and stop.

semantic_findings.title: Client-Controlled Checkout Pricing
semantic_findings.description: The public checkout method forwards caller-supplied ShoppingItem values, including price and currency, directly to Stripe without loading authoritative product data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented type exposes priceInCents and the backend passes the caller-provided item array directly into createCheckoutSession without product lookup or validation.

semantic_findings.description: The public checkout method accepts success and cancellation URLs from callers without validating their schemes, hosts, ports, or paths.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The backend signature accepts both URLs as text and forwards them to Stripe without an allowlist; the frontend-generated values do not constrain direct backend callers.

content.user_title: Build Stripe Checkout for Caffeine AI
content.value_statement: Adding card payments requires coordinated backend, frontend, and routing work. This skill provides a practical Stripe Checkout pattern for Caffeine AI applications.
actual_capabilities: Defines Stripe configuration and shopping item types for a Motoko backend.
Shows admin-only Stripe configuration using the Caffeine AI authorization package.
Creates Stripe Checkout sessions through backend HTTP outcalls.
Checks Stripe session status from the backend.
Implements a React Query hook that parses and validates checkout responses.
Routes users to payment success and failure pages.
limitations: The provided example does not validate product prices against backend records.
The backend example does not restrict caller-provided success and cancellation URLs.
The skill requires Caffeine AI authorization, HTTP outcall, and Stripe packages.
The result page guidance does not define order fulfillment or entitlement delivery.

use_cases.title: Add Checkout to a Store
use_cases.description: Create backend sessions and frontend redirects for products sold through a Caffeine AI application.

use_cases.title: Configure Stripe Administration
use_cases.description: Build an admin-only setup view for a Stripe secret key and allowed countries.

use_cases.title: Review a Payment Integration

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Checkout
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Stripe Checkout flow for my Caffeine AI app. My products are [product types] and my frontend uses [framework].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when starting a new payment integration.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Backend
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the Motoko Stripe backend for [project]. Use backend product records, admin-only configuration, and fixed allowlisted redirect origins.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when the product catalog and authorization layer already exist.

prompt_templates.title: Build the Frontend Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create React checkout, success, and failure components for [project]. Validate session responses and show clear loading and error states.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this after the backend checkout methods are available.

prompt_templates.title: Audit the Complete Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my Stripe integration for price tampering, redirect abuse, secret exposure, session verification, duplicate fulfillment, and authorization gaps. Propose specific fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before deploying a complete payment flow.

output_examples.input: Plan Stripe Checkout for a small digital product store.
output: Store product identifiers and prices in the backend.
Accept only product identifiers and bounded quantities from the frontend.
Create Checkout sessions with backend-derived prices and allowlisted return URLs.
Verify completed sessions before delivering digital products.

output_examples.input: Describe the expected checkout result handling.
output_examples.output: Parse the session response, require a non-empty Stripe URL, show an error for invalid responses, and use full-page browser navigation.
Restrict configuration changes to administrators, hide setup after configuration, protect the secret key, and validate allowed country codes.

best_practices: Load prices, names, and currencies from trusted backend product records.
Allowlist return origins and verify Stripe session status before fulfillment.
Keep Stripe configuration changes behind explicit administrator authorization.
anti_patterns: Do not trust prices or currencies sent by the browser.
Do not accept unrestricted success or cancellation URLs from callers.
Do not grant products from a success page without server-side payment verification.

faq.question: Which payment methods does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on Stripe Checkout for credit and debit card payments.

faq.question: Which backend language does the example use?
faq.answer: The backend example uses Motoko with Caffeine AI Stripe, authorization, and HTTP outcall packages.

faq.question: Does the skill include frontend guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers React Query checkout handling, browser redirects, result components, and TanStack Router paths.

faq.question: Does it secure product prices automatically?
faq.answer: No. You must load authoritative prices on the backend instead of trusting browser-supplied values.

faq.question: How should payment completion be verified?
faq.answer: Check the Stripe session status on the backend before granting an order, download, subscription, or entitlement.

faq.question: What must be installed first?
faq.answer: Complete the Caffeine AI authorization extension, then add the required Stripe and HTTP outcall packages.
